#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
hashtag: create, update and check documents built on htag_paper.cls and htag.sty.

Usage:
    python3 kit.py new DIR --title TITLE [--salt SALT]
        Create a document in DIR (which must not exist or be empty) from the template. The salt defaults to
        the name of DIR; it must differ between documents and never change.
    python3 kit.py check DIR
        Report whether the frozen files of the document in DIR are as shipped. Exit status 1 if not.
    python3 kit.py update DIR [--force]
        Replace the frozen files of the document in DIR with those of this kit. Refuses if one of them was
        edited, unless --force is given. Never touches the chapters, the preamble or the tag registry.
    python3 kit.py adopt DIR [--replace]
        Install the frozen files and the manifest in an existing document DIR/manuscript/main.tex that was not
        made by kit.py. Refuses to overwrite a file of the same name that differs from the kit's (an older
        build.sh, say) unless --replace is given; the old file is then kept as <name>.pre-kit. Never touches
        the chapters or the preamble; reports what is left to change by hand.
    python3 kit.py tag SALT LABEL...
        Print the tag htag.sty computes for each label.
"""
import argparse, datetime, hashlib, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys

KIT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
TEMPLATE = os.path.join(KIT, 'template')

ALPHABET = '0123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ'   # 34 symbols: no I, no O
DIGITS = 4

# frozen file in a document -> its source in the kit
FROZEN = {
    'build.sh': 'template/build.sh',
    'compile_one.sh': 'template/compile_one.sh',
    'computations/crossref_audit.py': 'template/computations/crossref_audit.py',
    'manuscript/htag_paper.cls': 'htag_paper.cls',
    'manuscript/htag.sty': 'htag.sty',
}
EXECUTABLE = {'build.sh', 'compile_one.sh', 'computations/crossref_audit.py'}
MANIFEST = '.kit-manifest'
VERSION_FILE = '.kit-version'


def htag_tag(salt, label):
    """The tag of a label, exactly as htag.sty computes it."""
    n = int(hashlib.md5((salt + ':' + label).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(), 16) % len(ALPHABET) ** DIGITS
    out = ''
    for _ in range(DIGITS):
        out += ALPHABET[n % len(ALPHABET)]
        n //= len(ALPHABET)
    return out


def kit_version():
    version = open(os.path.join(KIT, 'VERSION'), encoding='utf-8').read().strip()
    try:
        commit = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', KIT, 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True,
                                text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
        dirty = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', KIT, 'status', '--porcelain'], capture_output=True,
                               text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
        return '%s (commit %s%s)' % (version, commit, ', with uncommitted changes' if dirty else '')
    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        return version


def sha256(path):
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        return hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest()


def write_manifest(root):
    with open(os.path.join(root, MANIFEST), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        for rel in sorted(FROZEN):
            f.write('%s  %s\n' % (sha256(os.path.join(root, rel)), rel))
    with open(os.path.join(root, VERSION_FILE), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write('hashtag %s\n' % kit_version())


def read_manifest(root):
    """The manifest as {path: sha256}, or None if there is none."""
    path = os.path.join(root, MANIFEST)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None
    out = {}
    for line in open(path, encoding='utf-8'):
        if line.strip():
            digest, rel = line.split(None, 1)
            out[rel.strip()] = digest
    return out


def edited_files(root, manifest):
    """Frozen files that differ from the manifest. A frozen file the manifest does not list (one that a
    newer kit added) is not an edit."""
    bad = []
    for rel in sorted(FROZEN):
        p = os.path.join(root, rel)
        if rel in manifest and (not os.path.exists(p) or sha256(p) != manifest[rel]):
            bad.append(rel)
    return bad


def tex_title(title):
    """The title for main.tex: & % # _ are escaped outside $...$; \\ { } ^ ~ are refused there."""
    parts = title.split('$')
    if len(parts) % 2 == 0:
        raise SystemExit('title %r: unbalanced $' % title)
    out = []
    for i, part in enumerate(parts):
        if i % 2 == 0:
            if re.search(r'[\\{}^~]', part):
                raise SystemExit('title %r: \\ { } ^ ~ are allowed only inside $...$; edit main.tex for more'
                                 % title)
            part = re.sub(r'([&%#_])', r'\\\1', part)
        elif re.search(r'[%#]', part):
            raise SystemExit('title %r: %% and # are not allowed inside $...$' % title)
        out.append(part)
    return '$'.join(out)


def copy_frozen(root, rel):
    dst = os.path.join(root, rel)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(os.path.join(KIT, FROZEN[rel]), dst)
    if rel in EXECUTABLE:
        os.chmod(dst, 0o755)


def cmd_new(args):
    root = os.path.abspath(args.dir)
    if os.path.exists(root) and os.listdir(root):
        raise SystemExit('%s exists and is not empty' % args.dir)
    salt = args.salt or re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+', '-', os.path.basename(root)).strip('-').lower()
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+', salt or ''):
        raise SystemExit('salt %r: use letters, digits and . _ : - only' % salt)
    today = datetime.date.today()
    values = {'TITLE': tex_title(args.title), 'SALT': salt, 'DATE': today.isoformat(),
              'MONTH_YEAR': today.strftime('%B %Y'), 'KIT_VERSION': kit_version()}
    frozen_sources = {os.path.normpath(os.path.join(KIT, src)) for src in FROZEN.values()}
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(TEMPLATE):
        dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d not in ('.build', '__pycache__')]
        for name in filenames:
            src = os.path.join(dirpath, name)
            rel = os.path.relpath(src, TEMPLATE)
            if name == '.DS_Store' or src in frozen_sources:
                continue
            text = open(src, encoding='utf-8').read()
            for key, value in values.items():
                if key == 'TITLE' and not rel.endswith('.tex'):
                    value = args.title
                text = text.replace('{{%s}}' % key, value)
            dst = os.path.join(root, rel)
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
            with open(dst, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(text)
    for rel in FROZEN:
        copy_frozen(root, rel)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, 'notes'), exist_ok=True)
    write_manifest(root)
    print('Created %s (salt %s, hashtag %s).' % (args.dir, salt, values['KIT_VERSION']))
    print('Next: edit manuscript/main.tex and manuscript/ch1-setting.tex, then run sh build.sh.')
    print('Commit manuscript/htag-registry.tex after the first build.')
    return 0


def cmd_check(args):
    root = os.path.abspath(args.dir)
    manifest = read_manifest(root)
    if manifest is None:
        print('FAIL no %s: not made by kit.py, or the manifest was deleted (kit.py update --force rebuilds it)'
              % MANIFEST)
        return 1
    bad = edited_files(root, manifest)
    used = open(os.path.join(root, VERSION_FILE), encoding='utf-8').read().strip() \
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(root, VERSION_FILE)) else 'unknown'
    print('made with %s; this kit is %s' % (used, kit_version()))
    stale = [rel for rel in sorted(FROZEN) if rel not in bad and (
             not os.path.exists(os.path.join(root, rel)) or
             sha256(os.path.join(root, rel)) != sha256(os.path.join(KIT, FROZEN[rel])))]
    if bad:
        print('FAIL frozen files changed: %s' % ', '.join(bad))
    else:
        print('PASS frozen files unchanged')
    if stale:
        print('     this kit has newer versions of: %s (run kit.py update)' % ', '.join(stale))
    return 1 if bad else 0


def cmd_update(args):
    root = os.path.abspath(args.dir)
    manifest = read_manifest(root)
    if manifest is None and not args.force:
        raise SystemExit('no %s in %s; use --force to install the frozen files and write a new one'
                         % (MANIFEST, args.dir))
    bad = edited_files(root, manifest or {})
    if bad and not args.force:
        raise SystemExit('frozen files were edited: %s\nrefusing to overwrite them; use --force to discard '
                         'the edits' % ', '.join(bad))
    changed = []
    for rel in sorted(FROZEN):
        p = os.path.join(root, rel)
        if not os.path.exists(p) or sha256(p) != sha256(os.path.join(KIT, FROZEN[rel])):
            copy_frozen(root, rel)
            changed.append(rel)
    write_manifest(root)
    print('updated: %s' % (', '.join(changed) if changed else 'nothing; already current'))
    if changed:
        print('Rebuild with sh build.sh. Tags do not change: they depend only on labels and the salt.')
    return 0


def tex_without_comments(path):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return ''
    return re.sub(r'(?<!\\)((?:\\\\)*)%.*', r'\1', open(path, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read())


def adopt_todo(root):
    """What an adopted document still needs by hand, as a list of lines."""
    man = os.path.join(root, 'manuscript')
    main = tex_without_comments(os.path.join(man, 'main.tex'))
    preamble = tex_without_comments(os.path.join(man, 'preamble.tex'))
    todo = []
    if not re.search(r'\\documentclass\s*(\[[^\]]*\])?\s*\{htag_paper\}', main):
        todo.append('manuscript/main.tex: use \\documentclass{htag_paper} and delete the apparatus it replaces '
                    '(theorem environments, any margin-tag macro of its own, chapter code); keep packages, layout and '
                    '\\imported in preamble.tex, as in the template')
    if re.search(r'\\(frontmatter|mainmatter|backmatter)\b', main):
        todo.append('manuscript/main.tex: delete \\frontmatter, \\mainmatter and \\backmatter, which htag_paper '
                    'does not define; put \\clearpage before the bibliography')
    sources = ''.join(tex_without_comments(os.path.join(man, f)) for f in sorted(os.listdir(man))
                      if f.endswith('.tex')) if os.path.isdir(man) else ''
    if '\\imported{' in sources and not re.search(r'\\(newcommand|providecommand|def)\s*\{?\\imported', preamble):
        todo.append("manuscript/preamble.tex: define \\imported, as in the template's preamble.tex")
    if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(man, 'preamble.tex')):
        todo.append('manuscript/preamble.tex: missing; move the salt, packages and notation there and '
                    '\\input{preamble} in main.tex (compile_one.sh inputs it)')
    elif not re.search(r'\\input\s*\{preamble(\.tex)?\}', main):
        todo.append('manuscript/main.tex: \\input{preamble}')
    if not re.search(r'\\htagsalt\s*\{', main + preamble):
        todo.append('manuscript/preamble.tex: \\htagsalt{...}, a name for this document that never changes')
    if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(man, 'refs.bib')):
        todo.append('manuscript/refs.bib: missing; build.sh and compile_one.sh expect the bibliography there')
    return todo


def cmd_adopt(args):
    root = os.path.abspath(args.dir)
    if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(root, 'manuscript', 'main.tex')):
        raise SystemExit('%s/manuscript/main.tex not found; the kit expects the sources in DIR/manuscript/'
                         % args.dir)
    if read_manifest(root) is not None:
        raise SystemExit('%s already has a %s; use kit.py check or kit.py update' % (args.dir, MANIFEST))
    clash = [rel for rel in sorted(FROZEN) if os.path.exists(os.path.join(root, rel)) and
             sha256(os.path.join(root, rel)) != sha256(os.path.join(KIT, FROZEN[rel]))]
    if clash and not args.replace:
        raise SystemExit('these files exist and differ from the kit\'s: %s\nrerun with --replace to install the '
                         'kit\'s versions; the old ones are kept as <name>.pre-kit' % ', '.join(clash))
    taken = [rel + '.pre-kit' for rel in clash if os.path.exists(os.path.join(root, rel + '.pre-kit'))]
    if taken:
        raise SystemExit('%s already exist; move them away first' % ', '.join(taken))
    for rel in clash:
        os.rename(os.path.join(root, rel), os.path.join(root, rel + '.pre-kit'))
    for rel in sorted(FROZEN):
        copy_frozen(root, rel)
    write_manifest(root)
    print('Installed the frozen files of hashtag %s in %s.' % (kit_version(), args.dir))
    if clash:
        print('kept the old versions as: %s' % ', '.join(rel + '.pre-kit' for rel in clash))
    todo = adopt_todo(root)
    if todo:
        print('Left to do by hand:')
        for line in todo:
            print('  - ' + line)
    print('Then run sh build.sh. To keep a tag the document already shows, write it as \\htag{XXXX} right after '
          'the \\begin of its item; new items get computed tags.')
    return 0


def cmd_tag(args):
    for label in args.labels:
        print(htag_tag(args.salt, label), label)
    return 0


def main(argv):
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='kit.py', description=__doc__.strip().splitlines()[0])
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest='cmd', required=True)
    s = sub.add_parser('new', help='create a document from the template')
    s.add_argument('dir')
    s.add_argument('--title', required=True)
    s.add_argument('--salt')
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_new)
    s = sub.add_parser('check', help='check the frozen files of a document')
    s.add_argument('dir')
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_check)
    s = sub.add_parser('update', help='bring the frozen files of a document up to this kit')
    s.add_argument('dir')
    s.add_argument('--force', action='store_true')
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_update)
    s = sub.add_parser('adopt', help='install the frozen files in an existing document')
    s.add_argument('dir')
    s.add_argument('--replace', action='store_true')
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_adopt)
    s = sub.add_parser('tag', help='print the tag of each label')
    s.add_argument('salt')
    s.add_argument('labels', nargs='+')
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_tag)
    args = p.parse_args(argv)
    return args.fn(args)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

# {{TITLE}}

Created on {{DATE}} from hashtag {{KIT_VERSION}}.

## Layout

- `manuscript/`: the LaTeX sources. `main.tex` sets the title and inputs the chapters in order; `preamble.tex` holds
  the salt, packages, layout and notation of this document. Then `preface.tex`, `ch1-….tex`, …,
  `appendix-status.tex` and `refs.bib`.
- `computations/`: scripts and their outputs.
- `notes/`: working notes.

## Building

`sh build.sh` compiles the document (pdflatex, bibtex, then pdflatex until references and tags settle) and runs
the checks: tags, frozen files and cross-references. It reports errors, undefined references, labels defined twice,
unresolved links, overfull boxes and the page count. It exits with status 0 only if there are none of the first four,
the references settled, and every check passes.

`sh compile_one.sh ch2-name` compiles one chapter on its own; references to other chapters print as `??` there.

## Tags

Every numbered item has a four-character tag in the margin. `htag.sty` computes it from the item's label and the
salt in `preamble.tex`, so it does not change when items are added, moved or renumbered. A new label whose tag is
already taken stops the build with an error that suggests a free tag to pin with `\htag{...}`.

`manuscript/htag-registry.tex` records every tag the document has shown. Commit it and never edit it: it is what
stops a label's tag from changing and a deleted item's tag from being reused. `manuscript/htag-index.md`, rewritten
on every compile, lists the current tags with their items, pages and source lines.

## Frozen files

`build.sh`, `compile_one.sh`, `computations/crossref_audit.py`, `manuscript/htag_paper.cls` and
`manuscript/htag.sty` come from hashtag and are the same in every document. Do not edit them.
`.kit-manifest` records their checksums, and `build.sh` fails if one of them has changed. To move to a newer
hashtag, run `python3 <hashtag>/kit.py update .` here.

#!/bin/sh
# Build the document and run the checks. Part of hashtag: do not edit.
#
# pdflatex, bibtex, then pdflatex until references and tags settle (at most 6 passes in all).
# Reports LaTeX errors, undefined references, labels defined twice, unresolved links (links whose target is not in
# the PDF), overfull boxes and the page count, then runs the checks: tags (htag.sty), frozen files (.kit-manifest)
# and cross-references (computations/crossref_audit.py).
# Exit status 0 only if there are no errors, undefined references, labels defined twice or unresolved links, and
# every check passes.
# read the logs as bytes: they can contain bytes that are not UTF-8, and in a UTF-8 locale sed stops at the first
LC_ALL=C; export LC_ALL
here="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
PY="${PYTHON:-python3}"
cd "$here/manuscript" || exit 1
# one message per log line, and errors that start with "!", whatever texmf.cnf says
max_print_line=10000; export max_print_line

: > build.log
pass() { pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -no-file-line-error main.tex >> build.log 2>&1; }
pass
bibtex main > bibtex.out 2>&1
pass
pass
n=3
while [ $n -lt 6 ] && grep -a -q 'Rerun to get' main.log; do
  pass
  n=$((n+1))
done

errs=$(grep -a -c '^!' main.log)
undef=$(grep -a -E '(Reference|Citation) .* undefined' main.log | sort -u | grep -a -c .)
[ "$undef" -eq 0 ] && grep -a -q 'There were undefined' main.log && undef=1
multi=$(grep -a -E "Label .* multiply defined" main.log | sort -u | grep -a -c .)
unres=$(grep -a -o 'name{[^}]*} has been referenced but does not exist' main.log | sort -u | grep -a -c .)
over=$(grep -a -c '^Overfull' main.log)
pages=$(sed -n 's/^Output written on main\.pdf (\([0-9]*\) page.*/\1/p' main.log)
echo "LaTeX: $errs errors, $undef undefined references, $multi labels defined twice, $unres unresolved links," \
  "$over overfull boxes, ${pages:-no} pages ($n passes)"
grep -a -A3 '^!' main.log | head -40
grep -a -E "(Reference|Citation) .* undefined|Label .* multiply defined" main.log | sort -u | head -20
grep -a -o 'name{[^}]*} has been referenced but does not exist' main.log | sort -u | head -10
status=0
[ "$errs" -eq 0 ] && [ "$undef" -eq 0 ] && [ "$multi" -eq 0 ] && [ "$unres" -eq 0 ] || status=1
if grep -a -q 'Rerun to get' main.log; then
  echo "FAIL references did not settle in $n passes"
  status=1
fi

# tags: no htag error, and the tags settled
if grep -a -q '^! Package htag Error' main.log || grep -a -q 'Tags have changed' main.log; then
  echo "FAIL tags (see the htag messages in manuscript/main.log)"
  status=1
else
  echo "PASS tags ($(grep -a -c '^| [0-9A-Z]' htag-index.md 2>/dev/null || echo 0) in manuscript/htag-index.md)"
fi
grep -a -A2 'Package htag Warning' main.log | grep -a -v 'Rerun' | head -20

# frozen files: as shipped by hashtag
cd "$here" || exit 1
"$PY" - <<'EOF' || status=1
import hashlib, os
bad = []
if not os.path.exists('.kit-manifest'):
    bad.append('.kit-manifest (missing)')
for line in open('.kit-manifest', encoding='utf-8') if not bad else []:
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    digest, path = line.split(None, 1)
    path = path.strip()
    if not os.path.exists(path) or hashlib.sha256(open(path, 'rb').read()).hexdigest() != digest:
        bad.append(path)
print('FAIL frozen files changed: %s' % ', '.join(bad) if bad else 'PASS frozen files unchanged')
raise SystemExit(1 if bad else 0)
EOF

"$PY" computations/crossref_audit.py || status=1
exit $status

#!/bin/sh
# Compile one chapter on its own, to check it for LaTeX errors, overfull boxes and undefined citations.
# Part of hashtag: do not edit.
#
# Usage: sh compile_one.sh ch2-name      (the file name in manuscript/, with or without .tex)
# References to other chapters print as ?? here; that is expected. The chapter is numbered 1. The build happens in
# manuscript/.build/<name>/ and does not touch the tag registry of the full build.
# read the logs as bytes: they can contain bytes that are not UTF-8, and in a UTF-8 locale sed stops at the first
LC_ALL=C; export LC_ALL
here="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
m="$here/manuscript"
ch="${1%.tex}"
[ -n "$ch" ] && [ -f "$m/$ch.tex" ] || { echo "usage: sh compile_one.sh <chapter file in manuscript/>"; exit 2; }
b="$m/.build/$ch"
mkdir -p "$b"
cat > "$b/main.tex" <<EOT
\\documentclass{htag_paper}
\\input{preamble}
\\begin{document}
\\input{$ch}
\\bibliographystyle{amsalpha}
\\bibliography{refs}
\\end{document}
EOT
cd "$b" || exit 1
# this directory first, so that main.tex is the file written above; then manuscript/
TEXINPUTS=".:$m:"; BIBINPUTS=".:$m:"; max_print_line=10000
export TEXINPUTS BIBINPUTS max_print_line
latex() { pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -no-file-line-error main.tex >> build.log 2>&1; }
: > build.log
latex
bibtex main > bibtex.out 2>&1
latex
latex
errs=$(grep -a -c '^!' main.log)
over=$(grep -a -c '^Overfull' main.log)
cites=$(grep -a -c 'Citation .* undefined' main.log)
pages=$(sed -n 's/^Output written on main\.pdf (\([0-9]*\) page.*/\1/p' main.log)
echo "$ch: $errs LaTeX errors, $over overfull boxes, $cites undefined citations, ${pages:-no} pages"
echo "log: manuscript/.build/$ch/main.log"
grep -a -A4 '^!' main.log | head -60
grep -a -A1 '^Overfull' main.log | head -30
grep -a 'Citation .* undefined' main.log | sort -u | head -20
[ "$errs" -eq 0 ]

\chapter{Status of Statements}\label{ch:status}

% Long programs list every numbered item here by its status: proved here (with how the proof was checked),
% imported (with its source), conjecture or question (with its evidence), or remark. Short documents can drop
% this appendix from main.tex.

This appendix lists the numbered items by status.

\begin{center}
\small
\begin{tabular}{@{}lll@{}}
\toprule
Item & Status & Source or check \\
\midrule
Definition \ref{def:set-example} & definition & -- \\
Theorem \ref{thm:set-imported} & imported & Authors, Theorem x.y \\
Lemma \ref{lem:set-step} & proved here & checked internally only \\
Theorem \ref{thm:set-main} & proved here & checked internally only \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}
% Bibliography of this document. Take every entry from the source itself; never invent bibliographic data.
